%cumsum_add_s32 (lhs: s32[], rhs: s32[]) -> s32[] {
  %lhs = s32[] parameter(0)
  %rhs = s32[] parameter(1)
  ROOT %sum = s32[] add(%lhs, %rhs)
}

%region_0.1 (reduce_sum.3: f32[], reduce_sum.4: f32[]) -> f32[] {
  %reduce_sum.3 = f32[] parameter(0), metadata={op_name="reduce_sum"}
  %reduce_sum.4 = f32[] parameter(1), metadata={op_name="reduce_sum"}
  ROOT %reduce_sum.5 = f32[] add(%reduce_sum.3, %reduce_sum.4), metadata={op_name="jit(evaluate)/reduce_sum" stack_frame_id=7}
}

%dynamic_index_in_dim.2 (Arg_0.1: s32[1,64,4096], Arg_1.1: s32[]) -> s32[64,4096] {
  %Arg_0.1 = s32[1,64,4096]{2,1,0} parameter(0)
  %Arg_1.1 = s32[] parameter(1)
  %constant.12 = s32[] constant(0)
  %dynamic_slice.2 = s32[1,64,4096]{2,1,0} dynamic-slice(%Arg_0.1, %Arg_1.1, %constant.12, %constant.12), dynamic_slice_sizes={1,64,4096}, metadata={op_name="dynamic_slice" stack_frame_id=9}
  %dynamic_slice.3 = s32[1,64,4096]{2,1,0} custom-call(%dynamic_slice.2), custom_call_target="Sharding", sharding={devices=[1,8,1]<=[8]}, frontend_attributes={xla.sdy.sharding="#sdy.sharding_per_value<[<@mesh, [{}, {\"replica_dcn\", \"data\", \"expert\"}, {}]>]>"}, metadata={op_name="dynamic_slice" stack_frame_id=9}
  %squeeze.2 = s32[64,4096]{1,0} reshape(%dynamic_slice.3), metadata={op_name="squeeze" stack_frame_id=9}
  ROOT %squeeze.3 = s32[64,4096]{1,0} custom-call(%squeeze.2), custom_call_target="Sharding", sharding={devices=[8,1]<=[8]}, frontend_attributes={xla.sdy.sharding="#sdy.sharding_per_value<[<@mesh, [{\"replica_dcn\", \"data\", \"expert\"}, {}]>]>"}, metadata={op_name="squeeze" stack_frame_id=9}
}
